thread:
zoe: Heads-up: vuln team needs a scoped SIEM export for triage. Raw blobs are KMS-encrypted in s3://redwood-logs-raw/incident-2026-09. Request: 2h access window, strict no-persist, and cryptographic proof of use. Suggestions? :mag:
rahul: +1 on timebox. Prefer granting Decrypt via a KMS Grant to the log-proxy rather than editing the CMK policy. Add an EncryptionContext key `ticket` so we can prove intent. Also tag objects with `forensic:ttl=48h` so lifecycle cleans up.
tim: We should gate outbound movement: analysts get a presigned URL for redacted artifacts only. If they need raw, it must be through the proxy on an ephemeral bastion. Presigned URL expiry 15m max. Deny s3:PutObjectRetention and s3:PutObjectTagging to the ephemeral role.
rahul: Example KMS grant CLI (one-liner):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/0a1b2c3d --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/log-proxy --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"ticket":"INC-2026-091"}
```
rahul: Note: record the GrantId in the ticket and revoke after TTL with `kms retire-grant` or `kms revoke-grant` depending on flow.
zoe: Compliance wants to see the exact encryption-context values in audit. CloudTrail sometimes lacks the full context. Can the proxy emit a structured log event to the security index before decrypt?
security-bot: New workflow event: INCIDENT-INC-2026-091 created. Automated resources: bucket s3://forensic-ephemeral/INC-2026-091/, role forensic-jump-INC-2026-091 (TTL 2h).
tim: Proxy logging is the right call. It should log principal, GrantId, EncryptionContext, source IP, and a checksum of the blob (sha256) to the security-audit index before returning plaintext. That gives us non-repudiable evidence.
rahul: Also implement a short-lived IAM role with condition `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent` and require SSM Session Manager for bastion access. No console or long-term keys.
compliance: Two asks: (1) include a one-line radio log in the incident: "No raw copies persisted; access window 2h; CMK grants recorded" and (2) run a post-revoke verification that scans CloudTrail + S3 access logs for GETs outside the ephemeral-host IP allowlist. If clean, compliance will sign-off.
zoe: I'll update the runbook: create Grant + record GrantId in ticket, provision ephemeral role + bastion, proxy logs to security index, scrub pipeline produces redacted artifacts which are presigned for SIEM. Post-revoke verification job scheduled 1h after revoke. I'll open a PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
